test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90902b4209804831aa428a7d1dbfb2d6e20d08ad518d1fd07f5a321ac5d1ddea.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: Symbol '÷' has shifting a place in anti-clockwise direction in next images.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e98d4f6093b65e0c6fb56a9da3fca80f5bd8e346c99e0656eaf9c3d29361fd5.png] 

Step II: Symbol '+' has shifting a place in anti-clockwise direction in next images.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22a8f1c580db26b6357327b6e4be5fd080405c69dff6d74ce4f34a9c0f29956c.png] 

Step III: Symbol 'Square' has shifting a place in anti-clockwise direction in next images.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f7452f53ac9faf24427c725b150f081fff88e412baa344f15dc6af2cebc0da6.png] 

Step IV: Symbol '=' has shifting a place in anti-clockwise direction in next images.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a89e6082494e28af3d60d4e81d0746492d88914fb9ae0adc01b88a3efaf6c1a9.png] 

Step V: Symbol 'O' has shifting a place in anti-clockwise direction in next images.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/518ad62b211dfff16748d7af1afd0506fe02f4ae8fbdfea5a113e074c817694c.png] 

So, the complete series will be: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31e29ef79671a1ec915c4cd899ff63f92ecd8963a8649f6310a032c86f4449a3.png] 

So, 'Option 3' will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
